title: Before the Sun Burned Bright (Yahwe the faithful one)
content:
Lied auf Youtube anhören

Before the sun burn bright and rivers flowed,
I call you each by name to share My home.
No longer be afraid;
I am your God.
My love will never end,
Alleluia.

1. Though you have sent me, Lord, to every land,
I can’t find words to speak
Your ways of love. Ref

Before the sun burn bright and rivers flowed,
I call you each by name to share My home.
No longer be afraid;
I am your God.
My love will never end,
Alleluia.

2. The Lord reached out His hand and touched my tongue.
I give my words to you to speak my love. Ref.

Before the sun burn bright and rivers flowed,
I call you each by name to share My home.
No longer be afraid;
I am your God.
My love will never end,
Alleluia.

3. My hand will bring you words,
so speak them loud.
I am your Lord and God;
The faithful one.

Before the sun burn bright and rivers flowed,
I call you each by name to share My home.
No longer be afraid;
I am your God.
My love will never end,
Alleluia.
